defs.def: a small piece of paper with a design on it that you buy and stick on an envelope or a package before you post it 邮票

ex.s: The bees, butterfly and many other insects looked lovely and beautifully on the stamps.
ex.t: 蜜蜂、蝴蝶和许多其他昆虫在邮票上看起来可爱又美丽。

defs.def: a tool for printing the date or a design or mark onto a surface 印；章；戳
a design or words made by stamping sth onto a surface 印记；戳记
a small piece of paper with a design on it, stuck on a document to show that a particular amount of money has been paid 印花
the mark or sign of a particular quality or person 特征；痕迹；烙印
a kind or class, especially of people 类型，种类（尤指人）

ex.s: In that class, Miss Zhao, our biology teacher, showed we insects on stamps.
ex.t: 在那节课上，我们的生物老师赵老师给我们看了邮票上的昆虫。

ex.s: Many people have the hobby of collecting things, eg stamps, postcards or antiques.
ex.t: 在18世纪和19世纪，    36    （富裕）的人们旅行并收集植物、历史文物和艺术品。

defs.def: an act or sound of stamping the foot 跺脚（声）；跺蹄（声）

ex.s: Under this Act, all waterfowl hunters 16 years of age and over must annually purchase and carry a Federal Duck Stamp.
ex.t: 根据该法案，所有16岁及以上的水禽猎人每年必须购买并携带一张联邦鸭票。

ex.s: The very first Federal Duck Stamp was designed by J.N.
ex.t: 第一张联邦鸭票是由J.N."丁"·达林设计的，他是来自爱荷华州得梅因的一位政治漫画家，当时被富兰克林·罗斯福总统任命为生物调查局局长。

ex.s: Hunters willingly pay the stamp price to ensure the survival of our natural resources.
ex.t: 每一美元鸭票收入中约有98美分直接进入候鸟保护基金，用于购买湿地和野生动物栖息地并将其纳入国家野生动物保护区系统——这一事实确保这片土地将得到保护，供子孙后代使用。

ex.s: About 98 cents of every duck stamp dollar goes directly into the Migratory Bird Conservation Fund to purchase wetlands and wildlife habitat for inclusion into the National Wildlife Refuge System — a fact that ensures this land will be protected and available for all generations to come.
ex.t: 自1934年以来，已有超过五亿美元进入该基金，购买了超过500万英亩的栖息地。

ex.s: Little wonder the Federal Duck Stamp Program has been called one of the most successful conservation programs ever initiated.
ex.t: 北美水禽数量下降的原因是什么？

ex.s: The stamp price has gone down.

ex.t: 国家野生动物保护区系统

defs.def: to put your foot down heavily and noisily on the ground 跺（脚）；重踩；重踏
to walk with loud heavy steps 迈着重重的步伐走
to print letters, words, a design, etc. onto sth using a special tool 在 … 上盖（字样或图案等）；把（字样或图案等）盖在 … 上
to make a feeling show clearly on sb's face, in their actions, etc. 显示出（感情）
to show that sb has a particular quality 表明（某人）是 …
to stick a stamp on a letter or package 在 … 上贴邮票
to cut and shape an object from a piece of metal or plastic using a special machine or tool 冲压

ex.s: Stamp → 16 May Hi, Emma, ← Greeting I’m having a really great time in Yunnan, China!
ex.t: 邮票 → 5月16日 嗨，艾玛，← 问候语 我在中国云南玩得非常开心！

ex.s: The Lord of the Rings was published in three volumes in 1954 and 1955, and has become one of the world's best-selling novel 2 Every Christmas, an envelope with a North Pole stamp arrived.
ex.t: 《指环王》于1954年和1955年分三卷出版，已成为世界上最畅销的小说之一2 每到圣诞节，都会有一封带着北极邮戳的信封送到。

ex.s: Chinese characters are carved into small squares of stone and stamped onto paper with ink.
ex.t: 汉字被刻在小小的石方上，用墨汁印在纸上。

ex.s: You r friend, Me ilin STAMP 1 Read the posts and find out what each student’s reason is for travelling.
ex.t: 你的朋友，梅林 邮票 1 阅读帖子，找出每个学生旅行的原因。

defs.def: to put your foot down with force on sth 用力踩

ex.s: It also earned Carson a posthumous Presidential Medal of Freedom and put her face on the 17-cent US stamp.
ex.t: 这也为卡森赢得了追授的总统自由勋章，并将她的形象印在了17美分的美国邮票上。

defs.def: to stop sth from happening or stop sb from doing sth, especially by using force or authority 压制；镇压
to get rid of sth that is bad, unpleasant or dangerous, especially by using force or a lot of effort （尤指通过武力或不懈努力）消除，消灭，镇压
to put out a fire by bringing your foot down heavily on it 踩灭（火）
